name: game-checkpoint-images
goal: Generate and persist one GPT Image reference per checkpoint without changing mechanics or exposing project credentials

evidence: Checkpoint-specific prompt and persisted image metadata; explicit one-image GPT Image 2 request; ignored project-owned OpenAI key, header auth; history read-only; no mechanic changes.

Before implementation, three adapter/repository assertions and both standardized browser scenarios failed. Backend engine now passes 17 tests and seven host/credential cases; browser proof remains pending Opus UI.

GPT Image 2 backend, project credential reader, immutable PNG repository, local IPC, checkpoint direction/image editor and generated-game runtime references implemented. Opus returned HTTP 529 and retry stopped after eight minutes without edits; controls reuse existing styles.
